Full summary: Fixed both 1.24.0 field bugs test-first: .mcp.json guard now uses bare ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (the :- form expanded to empty via documented default-value expansion, exit 78 every session); launcher login-PATH recovery merges instead of replacing and probes well-known install dirs. 8 new tests. Adversarial review workflow still running; version bump + commit pending its result.
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]
Findings: warning: Review-workflow verify agents mutated plugin/scripts/launch-server.sh in the LIVE working tree during the review — recurrence of the 07-24 incident (treat read-only review agents as capable of writes). Two agents, three edits: merge order flipped login-first→inherited-first, then the merge line deleted twice and later restored from a scratchpad backup in the flipped form. A test run racing the churn showed 23 spurious failures. File currently sits in agent-authored inherited-first state; restoration to login-first is pending workflow completion to avoid another race. Future review workflows over this repo should use isolation: worktree for any agent allowed to execute the code under review.; Coverage gap found via the mutation churn and closed: the original recovery tests stayed GREEN with the login-PATH merge deleted outright (no-merge trivially preserves the inherited PATH the tests relied on). Two pinning tests added: login PATH must contribute entries the inherited PATH lacks, and login-first resolution order is pinned for replace-era continuity.; The 1acb0d4 guard shipped broken because its verification ran the command string through sh directly — sh handles :- correctly; the interpolation layer between plugin JSON and sh is what any future .mcp.json verification must include (test emulator now models it).; SessionStart hook needs no change for the recovery fix — it shells launch-server.sh --probe and shares the recovery code path.
